page.overview:
Who is Juilaine Madome?

Juilaine Madome is an Aes Sedai and for a while a loyalist Sitter of the Brown Ajah.

She is attractive with short-cut black hair and dark eyes. She is 5'7" (170 cm) tall.

Juilaine has a strength in the One Power of , average for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to Travel unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

Juilaine was born in . She was born with the spark and was a tomboy when she was found, climbing trees, running in the streets and wearing boy's clothes much more often than dresses.
